_comment: Which joint of the bone-mask witch follows which bone of the Quaternius Universal
Animation Library (CC0). Keys are the figure's joints, values the library's bones.
Measured, not guessed: the library animates 17 to 21 body bones per clip (feet, hands,
shoulders, neck and both spine joints included), so every deforming joint of the witch
that has a counterpart is listed here. The library's spine.001 never moves in any clip;
spine.002 and spine.003 carry the whole torso, and because a child's armature-space
matrix already contains its parents' turn, mapping the deepest pair loses nothing.
No counterpart exists for the library's fingers and toes (the witch has none) or for the
witch's skirt and cape (the library has none) -- those are driven under 'cloth'.
'root' and the two weapon sockets carry no deformation and stay at rest: the simulation
moves the figure, and the sockets follow the hands they hang from.
